summary: Homarr is a personal dashboard that acts as a central hub for organising your links and self-hosted services. It features a web-based configuration interface and aims to integrate with various external applications to display real-time information.
goodFor: It suits users who want a tidy, customisable starting page for their home lab or personal server environment.
watchOut: Depending on the complexity of your setup, configuring multiple third-party integrations can require significant initial effort and troubleshooting.
deployNotes: You will typically deploy this via Docker, ensuring you mount a persistent volume for your configuration files and sit it behind a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
